name: Orange
sourceLabel: SAMPLE. City of Orange actions on an SB 9 urban lot split application filed 2025-10-08, as described in HCD's letter to the City of Orange (2026-05-05), pp. 1-2. HCD quotes no city code; these are HCD's descriptions. Not the city's current form.

flags.itemText: The City declined to accept and process an SB 9 urban lot split application submitted on 2025-10-08, because it would create a parcel with only an ADU and no primary dwelling (as described by HCD).
The City indicated that converting the ADU into a primary dwelling "cannot be done because the City code does not currently provide a process for approving such a conversion" (as described by HCD).
flags.why: HCD found that an existing ADU "does not provide a basis for ineligibility" for an urban lot split, saw "no technical or policy outcome-based reason to prohibit the proposed conversion", and concluded: "the City must provide the applicant with a regulatory pathway to convert the ADU to a primary dwelling in order to process the urban lot split application."

citations.label: HCD letter to the City of Orange, 2026-05-05 (citing Gov 66411.7)

flags.note: HCD's condition: the conversion is fine "provided the project meets local and statutory requirements". HCD asked the City to respond in writing by 2026-06-05.
